title: PostgreSQL security_barrier analysis can expose hidden values through indirect expressions (CVE-2026-116327)
description: A vulnerability in PostgreSQL's security_barrier view processing allows database users to infer sensitive information that should be hidden. This occurs through indirect expressions involving leaky functions applied to CASE test values or internal parameters representing protected columns. The issue affects multiple PostgreSQL versions prior to 14.25.0, 15.20.0, 16.16.0, 17.12.0, and 18.7.0, and has been fixed in these releases.
